section_summary.extract_value: This introduction presents Study 1, which examines the psychometric properties of the Body Appreciation Scale-2 (BAS-2) in Iran. The text reviews the development of the BAS and its limitations in cross-cultural equivalence, then discusses the revised BAS-2 and its validation in other cultures (United States, Hong Kong). The study aims to evaluate the factor structure, internal consistency, and convergent validity of the Persian BAS-2, with hypotheses that BAS-2 scores will correlate positively with self-esteem and life satisfaction, negatively with BMI, and that men will report higher body appreciation than women.
